source: Theorem 3.3 / label th SSM lb general
exact_imported_claim: Theorem 3.3 proves that any k-layer state-space model solving the function-composition tasks under injectivity conditions must have total log state-space size scaling as Omega(m log|V| - q log|Y|), linear in the hidden dimension m.
assumptions: F maps V^m x V^n to Y.
There is Q of size q such that G(u)=(F(u,v^(1)),...,F(u,v^(q))) is injective.
The theorem's model success threshold is exactly probability 1/2 under an existentially chosen distribution D.
pass_condition: An independently checked derivation or certificate establishes a positive Omega(m) state lower bound at the exact 1/2 threshold.
falsification_condition: An assumption-satisfying scalable family shows that no positive linear state lower bound follows at the exact 1/2 threshold.
verdict_scope: The claimed linear-in-m consequence is falsified. The printed inequality remains formally true only vacuously because its asymptotic argument is non-positive.
